fields.value: Examples of Treatment at Precision Dental

fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.value: The images in our gallery show examples of treatment provided to patients at Precision Dental. They are intended to help you understand the types of cosmetic dentistry and restorative dentistry treatments available.

fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.value: Every patient's situation is different. The results shown relate to the individual patients pictured, and your results may differ. Each case required a clinical examination, diagnosis and a treatment plan developed for that person.

fields.value: A patient in the treatment room at Precision Dental

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Every photograph below is of a patient treated at Precision Dental, published with their permission. They are shown as taken, and the treatment and the time between the two photographs are stated on each one.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: These are individual cases. A dental examination and diagnosis is needed before anyone can say what is suitable or likely for you, and results vary between individuals. Any dental procedure carries risks and benefits.

sections.label: Section 5

fields.label: Text
fields.value: Results vary between individuals. Any dental procedure carries risks and benefits.

fields.label: Disclaimer wording
fields.value: Disclaimer: the material posted is for informational purposes only and is not intended to substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Results vary with each patient. Any dental procedure carries risks and benefits. If you have any specific questions about any dental or medical matter, you should consult your dentist, physician or other professional healthcare provider.

fields.label: Disclaimer wording
fields.value: Any surgical or invasive procedure carries risks. Before proceeding, you should seek a second opinion from an appropriately qualified health practitioner.
